summary: Inspected the single changed file `projects/FltRegularBernoulli/BernoulliRegular/FLT37/LehmerVandiver/CaseII/ConjAction.lean`. It contains 462 lines of formal Lean 4 mathematics: 25 theorems/lemmas with proofs, 1 definition (`caseII_etaInv`), 1 structure (`RealCaseIIData37`), and extensive documentation. The content establishes the action of complex conjugation on Washington ideals for the Case-II FLT(37) descent, proving key identities like `σ(𝔞(η)) = 𝔞(η⁻¹)`, class-group naturality under conjugation, and the resulting σ-stability of the anchored-quotient class. This is core formal number-theory content relevant to search.

summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content (definitions, theorems, lemmas with proofs) relevant to number theory and the FLT(37) descent. Hilbert92.lean establishes Hilbert's Theorem 92 for number fields with systems of units and relative units. IdealPowCancel.lean proves the key ideal p-th root cancellation in Dedekind domains. EigenspaceCondition.lean develops the eigenspace machinery for phi-Galois compatibility at general weight. FiniteLogFormal.lean provides formal power series identities for the finite logarithm. All are core formal mathematics that should remain searchable.
